title: From building a football ownership sim with AI tools to an AI club owner on Twitch — first stream today
author: New_Reporter_7382
selftext:
I’m Ran (ran6k), building Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner solo in Unity. I’ve used Codex/ChatGPT for C# development, interface iteration and promotional copy, and AI tools have helped with some art, voices and music. The game is a paid Windows early beta on itch.io.



The useful development loop has been playing the game, identifying a specific awkward moment, iterating on it with AI assistance, and checking the result in the actual game. For this update the focus has been a stadium that grows as a connected ground, club meetings, and better staged 3D match highlights. Passing checks alone doesn’t show whether those scenes feel right to watch.



Today I’m trying a related live experiment: Vince, an openly AI club owner, starts a new club in the game. His voice, face and words are generated. He makes club decisions and commentates, while chat can ask questions and vote on big transfers, contracts or investments. The stream is 13 October, 18:00–20:00 GMT+3 (15:00–17:00 UTC).



What I want to learn is whether a recurring owner character makes management decisions interesting to watch, and whether chat votes help viewers feel involved. What would you want to see from an AI host when it explains a transfer or investment decision?



Stream: [https://www.twitch.tv/vince\_pitch\_power](https://www.twitch.tv/vince_pitch_power)

Game: [https://ran6k.itch.io/pitch-and-power](https://ran6k.itch.io/pitch-and-power)



0.4.11 is out now. The game is still unfinished, with bugs and rough edges, and this is the first-stream experiment. No purchase is needed to watch. AI also helped write this post.
